description: This file is a shell script used for testing the disabling of git-over-ssh functionality, including setup and various test cases for repository cloning over SSH, handling of hostnames and repository names starting with dashes, and verification of wrapper behavior.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up the SSH wrapper for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that must fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the specified message.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Tests a git protocol URL with specified parameters.
